about.description: Analyses member activity in Telegram groups and channels: messages, reactions and polls per member, a user's earliest activity, and joins and leaves. The app reads with your own Telegram account and changes nothing in the chat.
about.privacy: All data stays on this computer. No message texts are stored, only IDs, names, usernames and timestamps.
about.built_with: Built with Tauri, React and grammers

guide.title: How to get the credentials (one-time, about 3 minutes)
guide.intro: The app reads Telegram with your own account. For this, Telegram requires its own credentials, which you create yourself for free.
guide.why_1: Telegram requires an api_id and an api_hash for every program that signs in with an account. They identify the app, not you as a developer. Despite the name “API development tools”, you don't have to program anything.
guide.why_2: A bot is not enough: bots cannot see old chat history and could not analyse past months.
guide.why_3: Your own credentials protect you: if all users shared the same credentials, a problem with someone else could block the app for everyone. With your own credentials nothing depends on how others behave.
guide.why_4: Creating them is free and only needed once.
guide.step_2: Enter your phone number with country code, e.g. +41791234567, and click Next.
guide.step_3: Telegram sends you a code in the Telegram app (chat “Telegram”, not by SMS). Enter the code and click Sign In.
guide.step_5: Fill in the form: App title e.g. TUA, Short name e.g. tua2026 (letters and digits only, at least 5 characters), leave URL empty, Platform Desktop. Then Create application.
guide.step_6: Copy App api_id (a number) and App api_hash (32 characters) into the fields below.
guide.note_private: The credentials belong to your Telegram account. Do not share them. The app stores them only locally on this computer.
guide.note_error: If my.telegram.org only shows “ERROR” when creating: choose a different short name, turn off VPN or ad blocker, or try another browser.
